name: Finite Difference Method (FDM)
summary: Discretize spatial or temporal derivatives on sample points to obtain algebraic approximations of ODE/PDEs.
summary_zh: 通过差分近似把导数替换成网格节点上的代数运算。
core_idea: Approximate derivatives using consistency-order stencils and assemble discrete equations.
innovation: Provides a direct differential-form discretization and numerical reference baseline.
limitations: Structured grids can be inconvenient for complex vessel geometries.
Stability and boundary handling require separate numerical analysis.

start_here.why: Authoritative derivation and stability background for this classical numerical family.
